articleTitle: General chairman's message
abstract: It is my pleasure to welcome all friends from home and abroad to attend the Fifth Asia-Pacific Conference on Environmental Electromagnetics, held in Xi'an, China.

articleTitle: Estimation of current distribution by near-field measurement
abstract: Approaches to estimate the current distribution on EM source such as antennas and printed circuit board (PCB) by measuring the near-field distribution are demonstrated. These approaches include the matrix inversion method and sampled pattern matching (SPM) method. All of these approaches require accurate near-field measurement and field-current inverse algorithm. Experimental results are presented and compared with the numerical results, confirming the accuracy and performance of these methods.

articleTitle: Mutual coupling reduction between two conformal microstrip patch antennas
abstract: A novel structure to reduce the mutual coupling between two conformal microstrip patch antennas has been proposed in this paper. In this structure, a parasitic tape is added on each microstrip patch element. With this parasitic structure, a 19.8 dB mutual coupling reduction between two conformal mierostrip patch antennas was obtained, while the antenna radiation patterns in both E-plane and H-plane remain unaffected. The field distributions of the mierostrip antenna were investigated. From the field distribution, it is seen that the mutual coupling is depressed by the parasitic structure. In addition to the good performance in the mutual coupling reduction, the proposed structure is easy to be fabricated and with low profile.

articleTitle: The latest design and development of the field mill used as atmospheric electric field sensor
abstract: In this paper, the sensor of a traditional atmospheric electric field mill was optimized. The earthing brush and photoelectricity synchrodetector were removed. A stator with double-electrode difference structure was adopted to produce difference. It was put in a signal acquisition and processing printed circuit board directly. The commutating pulsant signal of DC motor current was synchronously acquired to detect the phase of the rotor, which realized the identification of electric field polarity. Based on this, a novel three-dimensional electric field sensor was designed, and it was able to identify the polarity of the three dimensions at the same time, and the feasibility was proved by calculation and reasoning.

articleTitle: Statistical results on the emp conductive susceptibility of a serial network measurement and control device
abstract: The EMP conductive susceptibility of a measurement and control device used in automatic management system is studied by experimental test. Two EMP waveforms with different rise time are applied to the devices. Responses of the EUT are measured and compared. The sensitivity thresholds of EUT are analyzed by statistical method. Results show the EMP with fast leading edge tends to cause more serious interference when its amplitude remains the same as the EMP with slow leading edge.

articleTitle: Elementary effects in humans exposed to electromagnetic fields and radiation
abstract: Exposure to electromagnetic fields and radiation causes physical and chemical changes in the body provided energy is absorbed. Guidelines to protect people are briefly reviewed and its shortcomings discussed. A health factor (HF) is proposed. Radio waves, even with high information content, are not likely to be a risk of cancer.

articleTitle: Severity evaluation of immunity test for air and contact discharges of ESD generators
abstract: An immunity test method for electrostatic discharges (ESDs) is being specified in the IEC 61000-4-2, in which two types of discharges, contact and air discharges of ESD generators (ESD-guns), are given. To achieve an immunity test of higher quality, severity evaluation of discharge currents for both the current injection methods is essential. In this study, to evaluate the severity of air and contact discharges of ESD-guns for immunity testing, using a 12-GHz digital oscilloscope, we measured discharge current waveforms for both the discharges of an ESDgun onto an IEC calibration target. In consideration of low voltage ESDs below several hundred volts, the charge voltages were set from 200 V to 15 kV despite the IEC test levels from 2 kV to 15 kV. For a severity evaluation index, we used maximum rising slopes (peak current divided by rise time) of the discharge currents, and obtained them with respect to charge voltages. As a result, we found that at charge voltages below 5 kV, air discharges give current rising slopes higher than contact discharges do, and particularly at charge voltages below 1 kV, the rising slopes double and also have smaller variation. This finding suggests that air discharges at charge voltages below 1 kV can provide a severe and reproducible immunity test.

articleTitle: Application of the transmission line method to the shielding effectiveness with incident wave of arbitrary polarization
abstract: This work is performed to investigate the effects of normal incident electromagnetic wave with arbitrary polarization angle on the electric shielding effectiveness of a rectangular metallic enclosure with aperture by using an analytical method and numerical simulation A formulation depending on the polarization angle is successfully determined using transmission line method (TLM). A single mode normal incident transverse electric wave with arbitrary polarization is decomposed into two orthogonal components with electric field perpendicular to the long side and the short side of the aperture respectively. Each component is analysed in terms of TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf> mode by using transmission line method and then combined to obtain the shielding effectiveness. The result is validated by using numerical method FEM(Finite Element Method).

articleTitle: The potential of High Altitude Platforms (HAPS) for low interference and broadband radio services
abstract: A description of the use of HAPS for radio systems operation has been presented in this paper with reference to GEO and LEO satellites and terrestrial mobile radio communication systems. The wireless microwave power transmission concept using rectifier antenna (RECTENNA) elements has been presented.

articleTitle: Dynamic Spectrum Allocation based on Cognitive Radio
abstract: To settle the contradiction between scarce radio spectrum resource and the exigent requirement, effective methods of dynamic spectrum allocation are proposed in cognitive radio system. In this paper, game theory model and graph-coloring model are analyzed, which can improve spectrum efficiency and solve the deficiency of spectrum resource.

articleTitle: Optimal design dielectric layer of Lunberg-lens antenna
abstract: The analysis and the computation to the Luneberg lens center even dielectric sheet and the layered medium ball has been carried on in this article. The most superior coefficient of dielectrical loss variable equation has been obtained. At the same time the relation of N and the relative error has been analyzed, and some results have been got, such as the ideal Luneberg lens coefficient of dielectrical loss and the r/R integral and the N relations, and the general Luneberg lens antenna only to need about 10 on a lines.

articleTitle: Correlation between coupled voltage and discharge current
abstract: When the discharge voltage is +8kV and electrode approaching speed is 0.8m/s, the test results were sorted and investigated and several ideas are drawn as follows: there are better linear relations between the coupled voltage peak-to-peak value, discharge current peak value and current derivative maximum value. These three parameters are linear with the discharge current rise time. And the relative amplitude of several repeatable frequency points is not linear with these parameters at all.

articleTitle: A planar monopole antenna design for UWB applications
abstract: A planar antenna is designed for ultra-wideband applications in this paper. A circular patch as a radiating element printed on a dielectric substrate with relative permittivity of 2.65, thickness of lmm, and fed by a 50 Ω microstrip line. A gradual changing structure is designed in the bottom of the floor to improve the impedance bandwidth. Simulated and tested results show the proposed antenna can meet the ultra-wideband (UWB) bandwidth requirement of 3. l– 10.6GHz. The antenna has a steady-state gain,and omni-directional radiation patterns among the working frequency.

articleTitle: Investigation on ESD EMP damage effects of electronic components
abstract: 5 types of analogue or digital integrated circuits(IC) were selected as devices under test (DUT). The test results have shown that there were different electromagnetic pulse (EMP) sensitivities among different types of ICs. The avaerage damage voltage of operation amplifier was below 5kV The avaerage damage voltage of LF156 caused by EMP was three times higher than that of BG305. For 54 or 74 series of ICs, the average EMP damage voltage was between 8.5∼30kV Because of multi-input or multi-output ends of IC chips, there were several current paths and each path was formed by different devices. Usually three types of end paths were classified such as input-to-ground, output-to-ground and source-to-ground. It had been shown that input or output ends were the sensetivest ones and the source end was the un-sensetivest one. The average EMP damage voltages of 54 or 74 series of ICs were 20∼30kV,15∼20kV and 8.5∼13.5kV when EMP current was injected from suorce, input and output ends respectively.

articleTitle: Measurement at 820MHz for indoor wave propagation
abstract: Due to the complication of indoor environment, predicting indoor wave propagation becomes difficult. To study the properties of indoor propagation, we need abound measurement data. This paper presents an experiment for indoor propagation which was made in the corridor of top floor of a nine-storied building, CUC.

articleTitle: An improved adaptive finite element method for the simulation of electromagnetic field in PPFDs
abstract: Basing on the posteriori error estimation and Superconvergent Patch Recovery (SPR) technology, Elena Zhelezina proposed a fast adaptive mesh refinement strategy which can generate the refined mesh for the required accuracy with only one step of refinement. However, the strategy generates too many elements in PPFDs which is unpractical to simulate the PCBs and IC packages with complicated multiple layers, where the electromagnetic field in PPFDs is calculated, since too many elements lead to the FEM sparse matrices can't be solved on current machines because of inefficient memory. In this paper, a new formula to estimate the global error is introduced, and then, a new strategy to calculate every element's refinement degree is presented. Results show that the improved method generates less than half of elements comparing to Elena Zhelezina's method, but still requires only one step refinement. This mesh refinement strategy was successfully applied to calculate the electromagnetic field in PPFDs for simulating the PCBs and IC packages with high accuracy.

articleTitle: Feature extraction and pattern recognition of signals radiated from partial discharge
abstract: The artificial neural networks based BP algorithm is used to recognize two typical discharge patterns, corona and spark. In order to have a comparison, feature extraction based on waveform parameter and time-frequency analysis were used separately to provide the training input. The results show that the highest average recognition rate based on waveform parameter reaches 92.5%, while this based on time-frequency is 95%. On the contrary, the lowest average recognition rate based on waveform parameter is 70%, while this based on time-frequency is 90%. This indicates that time-frequency analysis is more effective and more suitable for discharge pattern recognition.

articleTitle: Application of genetic algorithm in broadband microstrip antenna design
abstract: Genetic algorithm is utilized in the optimization of microstrip antenna with complicated structure. A broadband single-patch microstrip patch antenna is proposed. Capacitance compensated technique and E-shaped patch are combined together to expand the bandwidth of the antenna. Genetic algorithm combined with finite element software is applied to optimize the structure of the antenna. The optimization procedure is also discussed. The reliability and efficiency of this method are proved by comparing the antenna proposed in this paper to un-optimized one. It can be seen that the bandwidth expands from 6% of the un-optimized one to 16%.

articleTitle: Shielding effectiveness of an enclosure with PCB
abstract: This article mainly deduces the new method of the shielding effectiveness, using transmission lines method to compute power, then we can use power to compute the shielding effectiveness with PCB in it. Because power takes into account the attenuation of electromagnetic fields in the high-frequency, compared to voltage method, we can get that power method calculating shielding effectiveness is accurate. This article is useful to the simulation of the microwace oven and other project, such as Computer chassis.

articleTitle: Influences of mesh size and lightning channel length on lightning electromagnetic field calculation using FDTD algorithm
abstract: One of the most important problems of FDTD method used in calculation of lightning electromagnetic effects is that the calculation is very expensive, time consuming, and sometimes even impossible due to the computer limitations. Mesh size and lightning channel length can greatly affect calculation speed in lightning electromagnetic field calculation. In this paper, Influences of different mesh sizes and the lightning channel lengths on the calculation have been discussed. Very strait grid can be used in lightning electromagnetic field calculation without any scatter object; however, too strait grid will cause error when scatter object is taken into consideration. The proposed 7500 m channel length is not necessary for lightning electromagnetic field in the vicinity of the channel. Shorter channel can be used to calculate the nearby lightning electromagnetic fields; closer the area we care about is, shorter the channel is necessary.

articleTitle: Non-stationary EMF surveying accuracy improvement
abstract: The paper discusses accuracy of non-stationary EMF measurements. The accuracy is mainly limited by applied methods of meters calibration. New method of calibration is presented. The method allows a limitation of the calibration inaccuracy to level of plusmn1 dB.

articleTitle: A domain map finite element method for solving open boundary electromagnetic field problem and its application
abstract: A domain map finite element method was applied to the three dimensional (3-D) numerical mode-matching (NMM) method to solve the 3-D electric logging problem. This method divides the infinite field domain of every layer into inner and outer field domains, in inner domain the matrices are formed by standard FEM and in outer domain, the Kelvin transformation is applied and the matrices are formed by a new infinite element format. Matrices of two different parts are coupled in the domains' common interface to form the final matrices of the original problem. This method generates smaller size of generalized matrices than original 3-D NMM method. In addition, this method changes the distribution of eigenvalues which needs less eigenvalues under the same error. Results show that the new method spends only 1/7 CPU time and uses only 1/3 memory of the original method.

articleTitle: Measurement of electromagnetic environment of Xiamen Island
abstract: The results of an experimental study on the situation of electromagnetic radiation in the city of Xiamen Island are presented in this paper. One of the mobile communication base station and broadcasting station in the urban are taken as examples to demonstrate the conditions of electromagnetic environment. By analyzing the collected data, some suggestions are given while conclusions are drawn.

articleTitle: Progress in IEC SC 77C High-Power Electromagnetics publications in 2009
abstract: IEC SC 77C has been developing high-power electromagnetic (HPEM) standards and publications since 1992. Most of the documents have dealt with the high-altitude electromagnetic pulse (HEMP) and intentional electromagnetic interference (IEMI). This paper briefly reviews the publications prepared in the past and discusses in some detail the three documents to be published in 2009.

articleTitle: The optimization design of power filter by Genetic Algorithm
abstract: At present, the most effective way to suppress EMI produced by power supply is by the use of passive filtering technique. It is too hard to find all the components to satisfy our requirement by the conventional low-pass prototype synthesis method. Based on current standard components, this paper proposes a match passive filter, which can be worked out by optimizing the Genetic Algorithm. The simulation result shows the good performance has been obtained.

articleTitle: Application of MW-FDTD to simulate the electromagnetic pulse(EMP) propagation in tunnel
abstract: To simulate the EMP propagation in large-scale and long-distances vaulted tunnel, an effective MW-FDTD method based on parallel computing [1] was presented. The convolution PML (CPML) [2] is adopted to truncate the computation domain, which reduces the reflection error greatly. The accuracy and the efficiency of the proposed method have been verified by comparing the results of the parallel FDTD algorithm with the proposed method.

articleTitle: De-embedding of board parasitics with T-parameters for S-parameter measurements of integrated circuits on PCB -examinations in one-port measurements-
abstract: In this paper, the authors evaluate T-matrix extraction method. The method is de-embedding DUT by T-matrix from actual measurement comprising both the parasitics and DUT. The proposed method were more accurate than that by the port-extension function. Result for different trace pattern gave similar results for RC series circuit up to 2 GHz. The calculated MSL parameter also gave consistent result for the RC series circuit up to 2 GHz. It was, however, found that an enough accurate calculation model is necessary to assure a reliable result.

articleTitle: Crosstalk analysis between two parallel micro-strip transmission line based on PCBMod
abstract: Crosstalk is an important issue in PCB design. In this paper the crosstalk between two parallel micro-strip lines was studied particularly using the EMC simulation software PCBMod based on the PEEC&BEM algorithm. Results were obtained on relations of crosstalk response to signal frequency, distance between two micro-strip lines, length of the parallel lines and height to ground. According to the simulation result, the effect of crosstalk amplitude is varied with the length of the parallel line, distance, height to the reference level. Finally, the methods to prevent the crosstalk in PCB were brought out, which are very beneficial to PCB designers.

articleTitle: The influence of discharge voltage on ESD parameters for air discharge
abstract: In this paper, a new ESD testing system was designed and the influence of discharge voltage on ESD parameters, e.g. peak value of discharge current, rise time and peak to peak value of induced voltage in a semi-circular loop antenna, and also the reproducibility of experimental results were analyzed used the system. It was concluded that as the approaching speed was constant, the variations of ESD parameters with discharge voltage were divided into three regions: 'Townsend region' 'Transition region' and 'Streamer region' the field strength generated at low discharge voltage was stronger than that at high discharge voltage, better reproducibility could be also obtained at low discharge voltage.

articleTitle: A consideration on the mismatching between the measured electromagnetic environment and the immunity test results for electronic apparatus -a case study on noise propagation characteristics in printed circuits boards-
abstract: It is experimentally clarified that the frequency spectra observed at the different points in PCB (printed circuit board) show the different patterns for the same pulsive conductive noise injected on AC-mains under the following three operating conditions of personal computer such as power off and power on (program running and no program running). Finally, the conceptual equivalent circuits of PCB for three operating conditions are proposed.

articleTitle: A method to simulate the electromagnetic parameters of materials with quasi-periodic microstructures and its applications
abstract: In this paper, a method to simulate the electromagnetic parameters of materials with quasi-periodic microstructures is presented and the parameters of fly-ash cenosphere particles are simulated. Results prove that the permittivity and permeability by this method coincide with that from the Bruggeman formula. By applying this method, it is possible to propose some strategies to improve the current cheap fly-ash cenosphere particles to be used as EMI-shielding materials and microwave absorbing materials.

articleTitle: Lightning discharges producing very strong radiation in both VLF-LF and HF-VHF ranges
abstract: We introduce the mechanism of the so-called compact intracloud lightning discharges (CID). Based on experimental evidence of multiple reflections and modeling, we infer that CID is essentially a bouncing-wave phenomenon. Some tens of reflections may occur at both radiating channel ends. The reflections have little influence on the overall CID electric field signature (narrow bipolar pulse (NBP) waveform), but are responsible for its fine structure, "noisiness" of dE/dt waveforms, and accompanying HF-VHF radiation bursts.

articleTitle: Design of low cost inverted F antenna with two parasitic elements for 2.4GHz WLAN
abstract: The proliferation of wireless local area network (WLAN) devices has placed a renewed focus on small, integrated, low cost antennas. In this paper, an improved low cost inverted F antenna with two parasitic elements is presented. Compared with conventional inverted F antenna, this antenna can produce wider frequency bandwidth by adding parasitic elements. It can be concluded from the good results of VSWR <1.3 at 2.4 GHz and VSWR <1.4 at 2.5 GHz, This antenna has great potential in practical application.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic calculation of cylindrical linear induction motors
abstract: The analysis of transient performance in the cylindrical linear induction-motors calls the distributing of motor electromagnetic field. Through the finite element method, we will get the measure of each parameter of the electromagnetic field and solve the issue of EM calculation. This paper introduces the process of emulation, and get the results of EM field distributing.

articleTitle: The standards of high power transient phenomena
abstract: The high power transient phenomena have attracted more and more attention nowadays. And IEC/TC77C is the standard organization taking charge of high power transient phenomena and its related information. This paper collects and clears up the series of TC77C standards, and describes the main critical content of each standard in detail. High-altitude Electromagnetic Pulse (HEMP) and High Power Electromagnetic (HPEM) are of the most importance. The content includes five parts, namely general, environment, testing and measurement techniques, installation and mitigation guidelines, generic standards. The standards provide the basic references for the definition and test procedures of the high power transient phenomena. Many countries make the related simulator tests and the standards summarize the valuable information.

articleTitle: Design of the electrostatic potential sensor
abstract: This paper introduces a new contact electrostatic potential sensor. The principle of resistance-capacitance voltage divider is adopted, and design in the way of integrated distributed capacitance. Adjust the proportion of resistance and capacitance, distributed capacitance is dispersed, so good performance on frequency characteristic is gotten; input impedance is augmented, partial voltage test method is adopted, so high-speed response characteristic is gotten. When the sensor is used the dynamic electrostatic potential can be tested real-time. The situation which the dynamic electrostatic potential can be tested real-time by non-contact instrument is changed. The high-voltage direct current characteristic and frequency characteristic are calibrated, and the result fits design requirement. This testing system is used to test the dynamic electrostatic potential of human body. Steady operation and rapid response are verified by the testing result. So the characteristic of the sensor fits design requirement,

articleTitle: Influence of branch geometry on radiation field characteristics from lightning return strokes in the time domain
abstract: Due to the disappearance of the geometric symmetry produced by the branches of the lightning channel, the characteristic of the radiation field is analyzed in 3-D rectangular coordinates using the FDTD method. Generalized perfectly matched layer (GMPL) is adopted in the underground to calculate absorbing boundary region with the finite conductivity of the ground. The results show that the effect of branch is to introduce free structure into the time-domain radiation field waveform and consequently to increase the higher-frequency content. Furthermore the relationship between the fractal dimension and space orientation and relative position from the main channel and the generated EM fields in the time domain is also discussed in detail.

articleTitle: Design of optic fiber transmission system used in the measurement of broadband EMP signal
abstract: A design is proposed for optic fiber system which is used for transient signal transmission, adopting OPA and FET as the input device of optical transmitter separately. The system receives and handle difference divide signal inputted. Through network analyzer, frequency respond of optic fiber transmission system is measured when two kinds of different input terminuses circuit are adopted. When square wave pulse signal is injected into optic fiber transmission system, time-domain respond of two schemes are analyzed and compared. From comparison, adopting FET as input terminus device of optical transmitter has much advantage than adopting OPA.

articleTitle: System-level construction of multiconductor transmission line capacitance matrix
abstract: The relation between MTL (multiconductor transmission line) capacitance matrix and two-conductor isolated capacitance has not been systematically studied, so classical methods usually adopt complex and time-consuming micro-elements analysis to compute MTL capacitance matrix. To solve the problem, a novel method uses two-conductor isolated capacitance to construct MTL capacitance matrix on system-lever is proposed, which chooses wire rather than micro-element as the unit for analysis to simplify analysis. Simulations show that the novel method is as accurate as classical methods, but the time-cost is much smaller than classical methods'.

articleTitle: Improving the reliability and EMC performance in speed regulating system of asynchronous motor
abstract: This paper proposes a strategy based on three-phase four-leg structure that can improve either reliability or EMC performance in speed regulating system of asynchronous motor. In the strategy, if the system is working orderly, the fourth leg functions in balancing the output voltage so as to reduce the common mode (CM) voltage of the system. During this process, the use of state exchange method not only breaks through the limitation of SPWM modulation index to avoid the extremely low utilization ratio of direct current (De) voltage, but also reduces the total harmonic distortion factor (THD) of the output voltage. If an inverter leg of system is in failure, the fourth leg acts as the redundant leg to take the place of that one. The transitory open-loop control is adopted to reduce the overshoot current and to switch leg smoothly. Thus the system can run uninterruptedly in the fault tolerant operation mode and the holistic reliability can be improved markedly. The effectiveness of the strategy is proved by simulation and experiment results.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic pulse's effects on insulin's bioactivity and mechanism study
abstract: Purpose: To investigate the effects of electromagnetic pulse (EMP) exposure on insulin's bioactivity and their preliminary mechanism. Materials and methods: A EMP generator was used to expose the insulin solution. Concurrent sham-exposed insulin solution was used as control. The effects of EMP-exposed insulin on fasting blood glucose of type I diabetes model mice, the effects of EMP on binding affinity between insulin and its receptor, and the effects of EMP on insulin's fluorescence intensity were detected respectively. Results: (①After EM P exposure, compared with sham-exposed insulin, the insulin's bioactivity of decreasing fasting blood glucose in type I diabetes model mice reduced significantly (P=0.023) (②Compared with sham-exposed insulin group, the percentage fluorescein isothiocyannate labeling of HL-7702 cells was significantly reduced in EMP-exposed insulin group (22.7% to 13.8%, respectively)③)Compared with sham-exposed insulin, the fluorescence intensity was significantly reduced in EMP-exposed insulin (P≪0.001). Conclusions: EMP exposure could significantly decrease the bioactivity of insulin by reducing the blood glucose levels in type I diabetic mice. This could be due to decreased binding affinity between insulin and its receptor. The mechanism could involve an alteration of insulin‘s’ conformation caused by EMP exposure.

articleTitle: Design of magnetic field sensor for three dimensional LEMP measurement
abstract: Determination of the field distribution in LEMP environment and estimation of channel current in lightening all require accurate measurement of magnetic fields. A three-loop fiber-optic transmission probe is designed for measurement of LEMP magnetic fields in three dimensions. The sensor is designed to measure the real value rather than the derivative of the incident field, which is convenient for vector synthesize and magnitude analysis. The design of the measurement system and verification of the characteristics are discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: Influence on discharge properties of esd subprocess from large speed of moving electrode
abstract: Moving electrode speed has strong effect on discharge parameters in short-gap electrostatic discharge. In view point of fluid mechanics, and based on Townsend theory and streamer theory of electrostatic discharge, theoretical analysis is presented to analyze mechanism of electrode speed effect on discharge parameters. An algorithm is proposed and the simulation result gives estimation of theory description proposed. Electrode fast speed weakens action of avalanche process while strengthens surface process in the whole process of electrostatic discharge. The result shows that discharge current raise up sharply with reduction of air pressure.

articleTitle: Nonparametric bootstrap estimation of confidence interval in base station test
abstract: In most test analysis, we always want to construct a parameter model, and then through sample statistics and model parameters, we can get the properties, or characteristics of what we concern about. Confidence intervals can give an estimate of the range within which the true value of the statistic lies. And a narrow confidence interval indicates the low variability of the statistic, which can give a strong support for the conclusion made from the statistical analysis. In base station test, we can barely construct an accurate parameter model, because the measured value varies with many factors. Without theoretical formulas, we can not get accurate assessment of the measured value. The Efron bootstrap statistical analysis can just solve this problem. In this article, we introduce several nonparametric bootstrap methods in assessing the accuracy of sample statistic, and the validations of these methods are performed with both Measured data and simulation data. We have found that all of those methods give an accurate prediction of the 90 percent confidence interval for the mean. And they can still work even under small data sets.

articleTitle: Cell membrane electroporation model in low intensity electromagnetic pulse
abstract: This article discussed the influence of the low intensity pulse electromagnetic field to cell membrane, establishes the cell membrane electroporation model, discusses under the low intensity electromagnetic pulse function the cell membrane electroporation theory mechanism. Through the computation under the low intensity electromagnetic pulse function the cell membrane both sides' ion concentration change, has proven under the low intensity electromagnetic pulse function in cell membrane ion concentration sharp growth. This to studies under the low intensity pulse electromagnetic field ion channel's characteristic, as well as the cell membrane electroporation research has the vital significance.

articleTitle: Effect of optical transmitter on the bounded-wave EMP simulator
abstract: When electric field is measured in the bounded-wave EMP simulator experiment, one kind of optical fiber measurement system is often used. At the same time, the effect of optical transmitter on electromagnetic wave distribution is often concerned. In this paper, we assume that the optical transmitter is placed on the working region of the bounded-wave EMP simulator and the Finite-Difference Time-Domain (FDTD) method is used to model the effect of optical transmitter on electromagnetic wave distribution. From the numerical result, we can find the law of effect of optical transmitter on electromagnetic wave distribution.

articleTitle: Research on EMC analysis of 1553B Bus shielding Cable
abstract: It is necessary to study EMC of 1553B Bus shielding Cables. Firstly, the history of 1553B bus system is presented. Secondly, the development process of the Shielding cables is put forward in detail. Point to the feature of 1553B Bus shielding Cables, the concrete research progress is analyzed. Lastly, the transfer impedance is chosen to measure the EMC of the kind of cables, through lots of measurement and calculation, the transfer impedance characteristics are simulated, and several important figures and conclusions are acquired.

articleTitle: The influence of the beamwidth of transmit antenna on RS103, radiated susceptibility
abstract: This paper mainly researches influence of the beamwidth of transmit antenna for RS 103, radiated susceptibility. The 3 dB beamwidth of typical transmit antenna was analysed. Lastly, Necessity of calibration for transmit antenna was discussed.

articleTitle: On simulation of response characteristic of EMI test receiver RF front end
abstract: Response characteristic of EMI test receiver RF front end was numerically modeled using the computing software Matlab. With the numerical model, the receiver IF response envelope of different pulse was simulated based on the requirement in the military standard GJB 152A. The simulated results may provide help for better understanding the performance parameters and operating the receiver, and also have laid a solid foundation for the following research on the representation method of EMI.

articleTitle: Study on the cosite interference cancellation using AIC technique
abstract: Cosite coupling interference between transmitting and receiving antennas is one of the main electromagnetic interferences in modern warships, and it seriously affects the warship's EMC and battling performance. This paper analyses the principle of interference suppression using adaptive interference cancellation (AIC) technique, and describes an implementing scheme. At last, an experiment programme and some results are provided to demonstrate the effectiveness of the designed adaptive interference cancellation system (AICS).

articleTitle: Stability analysis of ADI-BOR-FDTD method
abstract: The ADI-BOR-FDTD method has been proposed to simulate the transient solutions of electromagnetic wave propagation in structures with circular symmetry. It inherits the advantages of both ADI-FDTD and BOR-FDTD methods, with a memory reduction to cylindrical ADI-FDTD and no CFL condition restraint. In this paper, the Schur-Cohn-Fujiwa criterion was used to analysis the stability of this method.

articleTitle: Investigation on radiated EMI noise identification for high speed digital PCB
abstract: In the paper, a new approach by using near-field probes is proposed to identify mechanism of radiated EMI noises, i.e. CM noise and DM noise, according to but only the internal relationship between radiated EM field and near-field wave impedance, but also the inner relationship between wave impedance and measurement distance. Then, radiated EMI noises decrease obviously after suppressed by using 3-m chamber measurement. The research shows that the proposed method is effective and valid.

articleTitle: EMC design for an anti-jamming smart antenna system
abstract: This paper focuses on the Electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) design for an anti-jamming smart antenna system. The structure of the system is introduced, analyzed and discussed where the electromagnetic interference may arise. And the corresponding countermeasures are presented, which are diverse as the problems, such as metal shielding, grounding, multilayer designing, Printed Circuit Board (PCB) routing, filtering, etc. Finally, the EMC optimized design methods are adopted to achieve high reliability.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis of one electronic equipment
abstract: Electromagnetic simulation software FEKO was used to set up the equipment model and plane wave environment. Data showed: when frequency was lower than 50 MHz, the corresponding electromagnetic coupling field of the window appeared round distribution (x=13.4), but when frequency was higher than 250 MHz, the regional border of the window coupling field became more and more fuzzy; When frequency was 50 MHz, the back-door seam region appeared strong reaction electric current; when frequency was 650 MHz, the body surface of shell around the back door presented strong reaction electric current, and the surface reaction electric current of back door was relatively weak, which reflected the separating effect of the back-door seam; when frequency was 900 MHz, strong electromagnetic coupling area appeared outside the back door, the initial analysis was the transmission function of the equivalent aerial for the window; when frequency was from 250 MHz to 900 MHz, the reflection strengthen function to the coupling field around of the package within the equipment got obvious; very obvious resonance phenomenon appeared when frequency was 900 MHz.

articleTitle: Optimised radiative device of the EMP simulator with absorbing stuff
abstract: The radiative device made of metal sheet is the key part of an EMP simulator with absorbing stuff. In order to extend the effective work space, the radiative device is designed optimised. And the Finite-Difference Time-Domain (FDTD) method is used to model electromagnetic field of effective work space of the EMP simulator accurately. From the numerical result, we can see that the optimised radiative device can extend the effective work space largely.

articleTitle: Energy coupling channels and effecting mechanism of continuous wave irradiation to radio fuze
abstract: Based on introducing experiment equipment and method the irradiation effects experiments of continuous wave to radio fuze are studied Analyzing the experiment results indicate that the coupling channels of continuous wave to radio fuze are the antenna and shell body. The effecting mechanism is that the energy of continuous wave couples into radio fuze via the antenna and shell body, changes the working state of high frequency circuitry, causes the fluctuation of demodulation voltage, then results in the accidental explosion of radio fuze.

articleTitle: New technique for SE measurement of small enclosures within reverberation chamber
abstract: For various applications, there is a growing need to determine the shielding effectiveness (SE) of physically small (but electrically large) enclosures or cavities. In this paper, a new measurement technique for SE of small enclosures is presented. This new technique is based on the statistical methods and multi-points measurement. The work is intended to provide further refinement in the consideration of shielding effectiveness in a complex electromagnetic environment.

articleTitle: FDTD analysis of the potential distribution in reinforced steel frames of a building under direct lightning stroke
abstract: The back flashover caused by lightning could make serious damage to electrical and electronic systems within the structure under lightning stroke, and international lightning protection codes pay great attention to the problem. In this paper, FDTD method is adopted to calculate waveforms of the transient potential rise in the steel structure when the roof corner struck by lightning. Moreover, the peak distribution of the potential on each floor is discussed. The conclusions will provide theoreticcal reference for EMC design inside a building.

articleTitle: Radiated EMI diagnosis and noise modeling for cellular phone
abstract: In this paper radiated EMI diagnosis and noise modeling for cellular phone is proposed. With this method, the radiated EMI noise mechanism models of the cellular phone are introduced, and changing tendency of the wave impedance with the distance is described to diagnosis the radiated EMI noise type of the cellular phone. It is shown from the experiments that the proposed method is a fast and efficient tool for radiated EMI diagnosis and modeling of cellular phone.

articleTitle: Research on the interception power of finite object in plane wave
abstract: Scattering field is usually associated with incident field. When we mention scattering field, it simultaneously means an existence of incident field, and the complete field is the superposifion of them. However, if we ask what's the relationship between the scattering power and incident power of a finite object, it may not be easy to answer. In this paper, some new concepts, such as the theoretical interception power and medium factor, are introduced to study the relationship between the scattering power and incident power of finite object. The results can be used to calculate the emissivity of finite objects.

articleTitle: Information integrity and its protection in networks
abstract: Integrity is an important aspect of network security. Lack of integrity could result in many problems. In this article, the threats and requirements of the integrity are summarized. Some possible solutions to the integrity are discussed.

articleTitle: High voltage line electrical field influence upon suspended fiber cable
abstract: Suspended fiber cable close to high voltage line or electrical railway is under the electrical field influence. There are some different processes causing the cable damage. A dusting and moistening of sheath leads to current flow and surface sheath breakdown. The corona on the clamps gives rise to release of ozone and nitrogen oxides that can damage as metallic and dielectric constructions. The current flowing along aramid threads leads to water boiling and polyethylene thermal deformation and to swelling rise. Some aspects of these effects are considered.

articleTitle: Simulation and experiment research on shielding effectiveness of enclosure using Reverberation Chamber
abstract: The test method of shielding effectiveness (SE) based on traditional definition was given and its shortages were analyzed. The measurement of SE using reverberation chamber based on statistical property was propounded. The simulation results indicated that sampling at the middle line can reflect the shielding property of enclosures effectively. A new testing system based on the statistic definition and multi-points data collection of SE using reverberation chamber has been successfully developed. The SE of a small enclosure was investigated. Meanwhile, the results of repeatability test on traditional definition and statistical definition of SE indicates that the test method of SE based on statistical property has better repeatability and rather for industry application.

articleTitle: Thin-slot formalism for the FDTD analysis of thin-slot penetration considering ground reflection
abstract: In this paper, a new rectangular enclosure model for shielding effectiveness (SE) is established, which is in more accordant with practical engineering environment for it considered the ground reflection. The SE is analyzed by using different thin-slot formalism methods and the results given by C-TSF, ETSF and CP are compared with results of the finer resolution. When the width of the slot is comparable with the space increment, both ETSF and CP formalism are feasible, However, ETSF accords with finer resolution results more exactly. When the slot is far narrower than space increment, C-TSF is in good agreement with finer resolution. From the conclusion we can get a fast and accurate way of determining the SE through aperture of various sizes.

articleTitle: Research on HEMP injection and radiation effect effect of EED
abstract: High-altitude nuclear electromagnetic pulse (HEMP) will lead to EED misoperation (such as early burst) or degradation of the performance and reliability (such as failure) etc. This paper is mainly about injection effect test and radiation effect test of high-altitude EMP on EED, tests are performed in typical HEMP environments. On this basis, researched and analyzed HEMP effect on EED. Analysis showed that ignition energy of HEMP on EED is related with the DC ignition sensitivity of EED; the more insensitive EED is, the bigger ignition energy is. EED is seriously affected, in HEMP environment that is the rise time is getting shorter.

articleTitle: Study on the test technique of induced current of EED in electromagnetic field
abstract: According to the research and analysis on EMR hazards to EED, a new test method was brought forward in this paper, which is colorimetry method measured temperature with infrared optic fiber. The system includes infrared optical fiber that eliminates interference from external electromagnetic radiation, a lens assembly that optimally focuses the infrared energy from the bridgewire to the infrared fiber and no-touch the bridgewire, two infrared detectors that measure the middle and near infrared radiation from bridgewire respectively, a photomodulator and phase-locked amplifiers that depress the noises. Using the equivalence of heated EED bridgewire by radio-frequency current and DC current, a ways and means to quantitatively assess the safety and reliability of EED in the electromagnetic field are established through the calibration of sensors.

articleTitle: Simulation of electromagnetic transients in air insulated substation due to switch operation
abstract: This paper describes electromagnetic transient in basbar of air insulted substation due to switch operation. Transmission line model and lumped parameter model are used to model high voltage bus. Interference of transient in busbar to secondary cable via CCVT is model by coupling capacitor. Simulation results show reflections of electromagnetic wave during propagation in busbar have influence on electromagnetic interference in substation.

articleTitle: A non-positive-definite multifrontal algorithm for finite element analysis
abstract: This paper presents the Expanded Cholesky Method (ECM) for multifrontal (MF) algorithm to solute sparse symmetric non-positive-definite finite element equations. Optimization methods for reducing the extra demand storage space of fill-ins of MF algorithm have been carefully researched. Results show that the non-positive-definite pattern MF algorithm can be used to calculate a class of non-positive-definite electromagnetic problems.

articleTitle: Modeling of dielectric dispersive characteristics and the step response of transmission line
abstract: In this paper, a modeling of frequency depended dielectric dispersive characteristics of transmission line and its step responses are described. A dielectric dispersive characteristic can be shown by complex relative permittivity of medium. The Debye type and the Lorenz type dispersive characteristics are investigated. The equivalent circuit representations of per unit length parameters of the transmission line are derived for these types. These equivalent circuits are exact. The time domain characteristic of this transmission line is obtained by the Fast Inverse Laplace Transform(FILT). It is understood that when the resonance frequency of dielectric medium becomes near the inverse of the step pulse risetime, the step response is distorted.

articleTitle: An improved unconditionally stable WLP-FDTD method
abstract: An improved unconditionally stable finite difference time domain method with weighted Laguerre polynomials (WLP-FDTD) is presented. To verify the validity and efficiency of the presented method, an application example is given. Compared with the conventional WLP-FDTD method, the memory requirement and CPU time can be saved.

articleTitle: Application of Counter Propagation Deduction (CPD) method in transmission line impedance matching system
abstract: Impedance matching is an important problem during communication system design and multistage transmission line is an excellent solution. This paper suggested the counter propagation deduction (CPD) method and the corresponding conception, such as boundary originated sets (BOS) and deduction coefficient, and introduces the expression of V and I of every segment transmission line as well as the propagation deduction mechanism. Furthermore, combining genetic algorithm (GA), and by virtue of MATLAB tool box, the paper researched the application of CPD method while the multistage transmission line acted as impedance matching system.

articleTitle: The EMC research on mobile multimedia broadcasting system equipment
abstract: With the standards of system and related equipment being promulgated and implemented, China mobile multimedia broadcasts (CMMB) has already begun to broadcast throughout the country. The electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) of CMMB is becoming the focus both inside and outside the industry. In this paper, we preliminary studied the EMC of CMMB system such as electro-magnetic disturbance, electromagnetic sensitivity, electromagnetic radiation protection and so on. Then we proposed the focus of the future research directions, including limits and methods of measurement. At last, CMMB indoor coverage system equipment standards in EMC testing and evaluation issues were discussed.

articleTitle: Tri-band bandpass filter using DGS symmetrical split ring resonator
abstract: This paper presents a novel symmetrical split ring resonator (SSRR) defected ground structure (DGS) for bandpass filter (BPF) design. The equivalent circuit (EC) model of the SSRR was extracted and discussed in details. Based on the advantages of the SSRR, compact tri-band BPF was designed. The newly designed BPF showed a good agreement between the simulated and measured results.

articleTitle: A novel multiband frequency selective surface based on Y-loop elements
abstract: A novel multiband FSS based on Y-loop element has been analyzed using FDTD method. The simulated results show that the proposed FSS has the advantages of low insertion loss in pass-band, good frequency selectivity and stability of bandwidth. Its performance is very stable at various incident angles but sensitive for different polarization state at Ku-band for the lack of symmetry. Besides, there is no other resonance frequency from 10 GHz to 40 GHz expect the desired frequency (12.5 GHz and 35 GHz). It indicates that the novel multiband FSS has eliminated the parasitic resonance compared with the Y-loop fractal element.

articleTitle: PML implementation for WLP-FDTD in cylindrical coordinates
abstract: In this paper, a perfectly matched layer (PML) implementation for an unconditionally stable finite-difference time-domain scheme based on weighted Laguerre polynomials(WLP-FDTD) in cylindrical coordinates is presented. A numerical example is introduced to validate the proposed formulations.

articleTitle: Microstrip low-pass filter with wide stopband using coupled-line hairpin unit
abstract: A novel low-pass filter (LPF) with sharp cutoff frequency response and wide rejection bandwidth is proposed in this paper. The proposed LPF is composed of microstrip coupled-line hairpin unit, semicircle defected ground structures (S-DGS) and semicircle stepped-impedance shunt stubs (S-SISS). Sharp roll-off skirt and good out-of-band rejections are achieved as demonstrated in both simulation and experiment.

articleTitle: Analysis on electromagnetic field of coal or rock body fracture with taking a vertical electrical dipole as the emitter by the Counter-Propagation Deduction (CPD) method
abstract: A three-layer medium model set up according to the theory of electromagnetic emission of coal or rock body fracture with taking a vertical electrical dipole in the middle layer as the emitter is analyzed by the Counter-Propagation Deduction (CPD) method. The analytical expressions of Hertz vector and the magnetic field strength in the middle layer are obtained. The results may help to locate the area where coal or rock body fracture occurs.

Author Keywords: Zone of coal or rock body fracture

articleTitle: Pulse sensitivity of EED
abstract: In this paper, it describes the thermal response of pulse effect of bridgewire electroexplosive device according to heat balance equation. Sencondly, it provides the measurement procedure of pulse sensitivity of electroexplosive device. At last, it point out the Vital status of function time in assess the effect of pulses or EMC analysis.

articleTitle: Effect of the ground on the bounded-wave EMP simulator
abstract: In this paper, we assume that the bounded-wave simulator is placed on the ground in the experiment. And the Finite-Difference Time-Domain (FDTD) method is used to model electromagnetic field at working region. From the numerical result, we can see that the ground has great effect on the electromagnetic wave.

articleTitle: Standard resistor calibration method in measurement of noise source impedance using dual-probe approach
abstract: This paper presents the standard resistor sub-fitting calibration method in measurement of electromagnetic interference (EMI) noise impedance by using dual-current-probe approach. By this method, a more accurate noise source impedance and theoretical model are obtained. Experiments show this method is effective in noise impedance, and suitable for filter design.

articleTitle: Compensation arithmetic for electrostatic dynamic potential measurement based on system identification
abstract: Compensation arithmetic based on system identification was brought out. Via getting the standard import signal and distortion export signal through the standard calibration device of electrostatic high-voltage potential, the time domain mathematic model and waveform compensation have been studied by system identification arithmetic. Transfer function model was identified by the least square method. Result of simulation shows that system identification is an effective method to dynamic compensation of electrostatic high-voltage waveform measurement.

articleTitle: Study on the opening mode of high-voltage circuit breaker for SLF to reduce the electromagnetic radiation
abstract: The sudden change of the state of the power system will generate a strong electromagnetic interference, which could make the surrounding electronic equipments ineffective or even damaged. To this end, many kinds of protective measures have being taken, but their effect are not very well. In this paper, a new method was put forward, i.e. using the intelligent operation of high-voltage circuit breaker reduces the electromagnetic interference generated with the opening of breaker. For the opening of short line fault (SLF), the criterion of successful opening of breaker has been derived according to the national standard. As a result, the best opening mode of SLF has been determined to achieve the purpose of the protecting electronic equipments.

articleTitle: Analysis of the influence of the ground to TEM horn antennas for pulse radiation with parallel FDTD method
abstract: TEM horn antennas have been analysed before, however, few people consider the influence of the ground to the radiation of the antenna. In this paper we present the parallel FDTD method based on the Message Passing Interface (MPI) to analyse the influence of the ground to TEM horn antenna for pulse radiation. The numerical result is in agreement with the analysis of the method of images. Then different distances from the antenna to the ground are considered. Results show when the distance from the antenna to the ground is more than 40 cm, the ground's influence is negligible. However, when it is less than 40 cm the influence is great, and the fields near the ground have greater influence than other place.

articleTitle: Co-chairman's message
abstract: Electronics has been widening its field of application beyond the information, to general areas: lighting, motors for automobiles and small consumer electronics. The society is benefitted from it with energy saving and getting solutions for the environment problems. Engineering of EMC could be one of the key terms to achieve feasible solutions, and this conference will promote engineers and scientist to enhance their level of knowledge through the exchange of their experiences.

articleTitle: Modeling Debye dispersive medium in BOR-FDTD method
abstract: The body of revolution finite-difference time-domain method for dispersive media is presented which reduce a three-dimensional problem to a two-dimensional one, resulting in an efficient saving of CPU running time and memory requirement. To validate the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed method, we apply it to analyze the scattering from several dispersive bodies of revolution. Compared the result from the proposed method and theoretical value, they show good agreement.

articleTitle: A memory-efficient formulation with UPML-ABC for the WLP-FDTD method
abstract: A memory-efficient formulation with the uniaxial anisotropic perfectly matched layer (UPML) absorbing boundary condition (ABC) is presented for the unconditionally stable FDTD method combined with weighted Laguerre polynomials (WLP). The divergence theorem is applied to the UPML absorber. This leads to a memory-efficient matrix equation. The validity of the proposed method is shown through a numerical example of scattering from a two dimensional (2-D) rectangular conductor.

articleTitle: Characterization of radiated EMI generated by digital wireless speaker
abstract: In the paper, a fast analysis method by using near-field probes is proposed to diagnose radiated EMI mechanism for digital wireless speaker based on the inner relationship between radiated electromagnetic (EM) field and wave impedance. The results show CM noise dominates radiated EMI noise when frequency is below 300 MHz. Furthermore, a new method by using radio frequency (RF) circuit probes is used to estimate radiated EMI noise. By analyzing measurement in 3-m chamber with Ferrite Core or not, the research shows that the proposed method is convenient and efficient.

articleTitle: Research on the substitute method of electromagnetic emulation for reverberation chamber
abstract: Finite array of continuous wave superposition was adopted to simulate electromagnetic environment of reverberation chamber. Using this equivalent method it is not necessary to divide cavity mesh grid and calculate the reflect process of the chamber cavity time after time. So it becomes possible for electric large scale reverberation chamber to carry out high frequency electromagnetic emulation.

articleTitle: Arbitrary shape of prism invisibility cloak
abstract: Based on the coordinate transformation theory, arbitrary prism invisibility cloaks which is composed of complex, anisotropic and inhomogeneous materials are designed, the permittivity and permeability tensors of the materials are deduced for arbitrary prism cloaks. Such cloaks should be effective at all frequencies. Numerical simulation results are given to validate the arbitrary prism invisibility cloaking.

articleTitle: A comparison of incorporation of dissipation in the FDTD analysis of transmission lines using stability analysis
abstract: A comparison of incorporation schemes of dissipation in the FDTD analysis of transmission lines using stability analysis is described. In the leapfrog type FDTD method, the calculation points of the voltage and the current are different in the time space. Therefore, how dissipation is included in the update equation becomes a problem. We find that incorporation of dissipation by using average value is more stable and lower numerical dispersion than that of Yee when discretization interval is large. Oppositely, Yee's scheme is more accurate in case of discretization interval is small. This is confirmed from the accuracy in numerical analysis of pulse responses.

articleTitle: Research of 2.45GHZ continuous wave magnetron harmonic
abstract: In this paper, a simulation model is established and a dynamic simulation analysis is made for the 2.45GHz continuous-wave magnetron using the large-scale electromagnetic PIC simulation software. By simulating interaction between electron and high frequency field in operating conditions of Magnetron, the output power, spectrum and other dynamic characteristics are obtained, the results are essential to the improvement of magnetron EMI performance and the collaborative design of microwave ovens EMI performance.

articleTitle: Theoretical analysis and experimental research on TGR
abstract: The predigested physical model is set up in this paper according to the geometry shape of the earthing electrode, and the finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method is used to get the Transient Grounding Resistance (TGR) waveform of the earthing electrode, based on the experimental method. It is showed that the calculation results and the experimental results match well.

articleTitle: Source charge model and its application in simulation of lightning discharges
abstract: Source charge model is reviewed and is used to analyze electric field changes caused by eight directions of lightning streamers. Moreover, an improved piecewise-linear source charge model combined with the three-dimensional radiation source mapping results to interpret electric field changes on the ground is proposed. This model is applied to simulating E-field waveform and calculating electric parameters within initial streamer and the K event in an intracloud flash. The simulation result is consistent with the measured waveform. Mean charge line densities, currents and transferred charges of two processes are estimated: for the initial streamer, they are 0.53 C/km, 188.2 A, and 3.8 C, respectively; while for the K event, they are varying with the development of the channel.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic field attenuation in magnetodielectric cable sheath
abstract: For electromagnetic protection of communication cable it can apply different ways: metallic screen, earthing, protector etc. Metallic screen is subjected to corrosion. Plastic hose over screen strongly deteriorates screen behavior. Conducting magnetodielectric screen corrects situation. It is interesting to know attenuation of fields, which are passing through jacket from within and from out side. In this paper an electromagnetic field attenuation in magnetodielectric calculating method is offering.

articleTitle: Systematic comparison of various kinds of higher order vector elements for triangles
abstract: In this paper, the characteristic and performance of different kinds of 2D triangular interpolatory vector elements are compared systematically and explicitly. Nedelec's functional spaces and Nedelec constraints are discussed, and some important properties of various vector elements are analyzed. The performance of different vector elements is then compared through numerical examples.

articleTitle: Power network disturbances due to the presence of FACTS
abstract: The necessity to take into account environment problems and in parallel a need for more energy, for the development of emerging economies, makes the management of energy sources a very important problem. The electric transmission network is charged with more loads and consumers. The power control is performed today using power electronics installations, in particular the flexible alternating current transmission systems (FACTS). The proliferation of power electronic installations is the cause of higher harmonic pollution in the power grid. As the utility of the FACTS for the management of modern power networks is evident, measures must be taken in order to reduce the created harmonics using various methods. The paper will discuss the admissible limits of harmonics in the network, as defined by the IEC norms and will briefly present some methods used to reduce the harmonic content and level.

articleTitle: Design and simulation of impulse current circuit based on the standard lightning currents
abstract: From the linear RLC circuit of impulse current generator, the relations between the parameters T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>, T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, i<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub> of pulsed current wave and damping coefficient parameters alpha of the circuit ware studies in this paper. The currents parameters of impulse current generator which can generate the standard lightning currents (100kA, 8/20mus and 50kA, 10/350mus) were calculated by using the relations, and simulated in Pspice.

articleTitle: Research on the calibration equipment for electrostatic dynamic high voltage
abstract: In order to solve the metrological calibration are acquired by data acquirement problem for electrostatic dynamic voltmeter, system synchronously. Through measuring and the high stability controllable high voltage comparing of parameter, the performance of pulse power supply, standard pulse voltage instrument under calibration is calibrated. It divider and data acquirement system based on makes that the output stability doesn't directly virtual instrument were developed. The affects the measuring uncertainty of the calibration equipment of extended uncertainty calibration equipment. 0.3% for electrostatic dynamic high voltage was established.

articleTitle: Research on remote EMC testing system
abstract: With quick development and use of microelectronic technique in modern industry, EMC problems of equipments become more and more complex. In order to satisfy quick testing requirement, the paper presents an architecture for remote EMC testing system. The system integrates virtual instrument and network technique for real-time data acquisition, transmission and instrument control. Its distributed structure, providing testing data for different experts far from equipment under test, is undoubtedly beneficial for solving EMC problems in time.

articleTitle: Effect of electromagnetic pulse on the changes of myocardial enzyme spectrumin in the canis familiaris
abstract: This article aim to investigate the effects of electromagnetic pulses (EMP) on the changes of myocardial enzyme spectrumin in the canis familiaris. To activitives of creatine kinase(CK), creatine kinase isoenzyme(CK-mb), lactic dehydrogenase(LDH) and alpha-hydroxybutyric dehydrogenase (alpha-HBDH) in the blood serum of canis familiaris were examined by Half Routine Blood Biochemical Analyses at the 1 day, 3 day, 5 day after EMP exposure ( 100, 1000, 10000 pulses). The results showed that myocardial enzyme spectrum disturbance occurred after EMP irradiation. Compared with the control, the activitives of CK, CK-mb and LDH were increased, but a-HBDH was decreased. In conclusions EMP exposure can markedly changed on myocardial enzyme activities in the blood serum of canis familiaris.

articleTitle: Simulation of nerve action potential under different temperature
abstract: Nerve cells under different temperature show various characteristics when they are stimulated and generate action potential, the principal ions involved in the action potential such as sodium and potassium cations also present different possibility to pass through the nerve membrane as well, higher temperature results in a shorter time for this reversible process. The purpose of this study is to find out the relationship between the temperature and the waveforms that action potential generates. We also explored the effect that temperature brings to the ion gate conductance, especially on sodium and potassium. Simulation results are in good agreement with the known phenomena. The method of this work could be applied to acupuncture and moxibustion as well.

articleTitle: A fast measurement and estimation approach applied in radiated EMI analysis of high-frequency circuit
abstract: The recent research for radiated electromagnetic interference (EMI) analysis is often relied on electromagnetic field measurement like OATS and anechoic chamber measurement, which is not only expensive, but also complicated to some extent and not easily done in practice for fast analysis. To solve this problem, a fast measurement and estimation approach is presented based on current probe measurement and voltage probe measurement, where the radiated EMI performance generated by high-frequency (HF) circuit can be evaluated directly according to current and voltage measurement results. It is shown from the experiments that the results achieved by current and voltage measurement-based method in this paper basically agree well with the EM measurement results, which means the new method can be utilized in radiated EMI estimation with the advantage of simplicity, fast implementation and low-cost.

articleTitle: Experimental research on effects of LEMP on power circuits
abstract: Two types of familiar DC power, switching power and integrated voltage regulator (IVR) power were chosen as study objects, the injection experiments and radiation experiments of LEMP on power circuits were studied and experimental results of injection and radiation were compared and discussed. The results show that injection method and radiation method are irrelevant, and not only injection effects but also radiation effects should be considered to estimate lightning effects.

articleTitle: Comparison of the measurement method for surface transfer impedance in frequency-domain and time-domain
abstract: Aimed to acquire the screening efficiency of the shielded coaxial cable a time-domain measurement method is proposed and a test system based on the triaxial test fixture is designed. By using FFT, time-domain test result can be transformed in to frequency-domain. Comparison shows they fit well with each other. The proposed time-domain test method provides a more straight way to observe the screen efficiency of cables under pulsed fields.

articleTitle: Application of EMI noise separating network for predicting radiated noise in power-line communication system
abstract: A novel method is proposed to estimate the radiated EMI noise for power-line communication (PLC), where the EMI noise separation is utilized to obtain the common mode (CM) current. Furthermore, the radiated EMI noise can be estimated according to the relationship between the radiated EM field and the CM current. The experiment results show that the radiated EMI noise is decreased obviously, while the CM current is suppressed by using ferrite core or CM filter, and the proposed method is effective and valid.

articleTitle: A typical electronic system illuminated by Ultra-wide Band
abstract: A typical electronic systems with long signal transmission line illuminated by an ultra-wide band (UWB) pulse generator has been presented The test shows that: interference will be induced into the ground equipment, and working signals will be distorted under such condition. An `antenna model' of the transmission line is presented The main reason of the interference induced into the system is that there is no design of filtering for the input signal circuit of ground equipment. Measurements of adopting high-frequency filtering techniques or replacing the transmission line with optic-fiber may improve the performance or anti-interference.

articleTitle: Two atypical methods for ship RCS measurement with the laser and the acoustic wave technique
abstract: Nowadays, the measurement methods for ship radar cross section (RCS) are of many kinds, but the traditional ones exist some shortages. In view of this situation, this paper mainly presents two atypical methods for ship RCS measurements, which are respectively based on the laser and the acoustic wave technology. Using scaled theory to test the target, both of the two methods can to some certain extent make up the deficiencies of the typical ones. The former method gradually trends from theory to experiment, while the latter has formed a test system. The proposed atypical methods make a significance to the measurement of ship RCS, whether in theory or in project practice.

articleTitle: Simulation of the effects of polarization and incident angle of plane wave on the field distribution of enclosure with apertures
abstract: Shielding effectiveness (SE) of small enclosures within reverberation chamber is an important topic in EMC society in recent years. Since the field propagation within a reverberation chamber is randomly polarized and isotropic, it is useful to investigate the effect of polarization and incident angle of plane wave on the field distribution within a enclosure with aperture. The effects of polarization and incident angle of plane wave on the field distribution in a enclosure is simulated. The results provide the bases for further research on the shielding effectiveness of enclosure using reverberation chamber.

articleTitle: Effects of EMP irradiation on production of IL-2 in spleen cells of mice
abstract: AIM To investigate the bioeffects of EMP irradiation on the mouse immune system. METHODS EMP irradiation (field intensity: 57 kV/m, 300000 pulses, at free posture), Concentration of IL-2 in supematants of mouse spleen cells in groups of control and EMP irradiation was examined by ELISA. RESULTS Concentration of lL- 2 was 50.7 plusmn 24.7 (P = 0.285), 169.6 plusmn 63.9 (P < 0.01), 52.2 plusmn 12.4 (P = 0.319), 263.9 plusmn 31.5(P < 0.01) and 85.9 plusmn 24.3 (pg/ml) in groups of 6 h, 24 h, 48 h, 96 h after EMP irradiation and control respectively. IL-2 concentration in groups of 24 h and 96 h after EMP irradiation significantly increased (2 times and 3 times of control group respectively, P < 0.01). While compared with that of control group, IL-2 concentration in groups of 6 h and 48 h after EMP irradiation decreased (about 40 percent, P < 0.05). In phases, IL-2 concentration went down and up, then down and up again, just like a Cosine wave. CONCLUSION Results demonstrate that the production of IL-2 in spleen cells of mice fluctuates at different time after EMP irradiation under our experimental conditions.

articleTitle: Goos-Hänchen and focal shift of a reflected beam at a dielectric interface
abstract: Nonspecular effect of a microwave beam associated with totalreflection(TR') is investigated by means of establishing ray model and angular spectrum representation. These approachs predicts the existence of not only a well-known Goos-Hänchen shift(GHS) but also a focal shift. The focal shifts are evaluated at a single dielectric interface, and approximate expressions are derived. At last, we conclude some properties as to the focal shift based on numerical analysis.

articleTitle: The high precision frequency measurement base on direction estimation system
abstract: Frequency estimation plays a crucial role in direction estimation system, of which the measurement error may directly influence the reliability of orientation measurement results. Consequently, to improve the precision of frequency estimation becomes very necessary. This article describes the causing of barrier affection, analyses the characteristic of CZT (Chrip-Z transform), and proposes a hybrid method that combines FFT with CZT to estimate signal frequency. And fmally, it makes use of Matlab to simulate in order to validate this method.

articleTitle: Estimation of radiated emissions from multilayered printed circuit board by common-mode antenna model
abstract: In this paper, we calculated radiated emissions from multilayered PCBs using common-mode antenna models. We described brief description of a common-mode antenna model first, and illustrated that the common-mode antenna model is useful to calculate radiated emissions from 3-layered PCBs. In addition to that, radiated emissions from a 4-layered PCB with the two planes, a GND plane and a power plane, connected by a via, were calculated. Power-bus resonance appeared there on the 4-layered PCB. Then, we calculated the whole radiation from the 4-layered PCB using the common-mode antenna model which were superimposed on a power-bus resonance model by vector sum. The calculated result of the model had good agreement with the radiation from the 4-layered PCB that were numerically obtained. Thus, a common-mode antenna model is an useful model to calculate radiation from a multilayered PCB which has a complicatd structure as in an actual PCB.
